page_title: REN 3-1 CLE | Rennes v Clermont 18/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+1' Substitution. Amine Gouiri leaves the pitch and is replaced by Djaoui Cisse (Rennes).
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Rennes was in an offside position.
88' A quickly taken corner by Rennes.
88' Guela Doue (Rennes) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Rennes get a corner.
87' Pascal Gastien has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cheick Oumar Konate (Clermont) replacing Bilal Boutobba.
87' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) is ready on the edge of the six-yard box and duly receives the cross, but his header fizzes just wide of the left post.
82' The referee signals a substitution. Jeremie Bela (Clermont) is brought on as a substitute for Jim Allevinah.
82' It is time for a substitution. Florent Ogier (Clermont) is on for Shamar Nicholson.
82' Julien Stephan prepares a substitution. Alidu Seidu is replaced by Adrien Truffert (Rennes).
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jeanuel Belocian as he is replaced by Guela Doue (Rennes).
82' Martin Terrier (Rennes) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
80' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) unloads a good strike from the free kick just outside the box. His low effort towards the bottom left corner is stopped by Mory Diaw, who pulls off a glorious save!
77' Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont) makes a horrible challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
75' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
73' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post.
73' Johan Gastien (Clermont) will take a corner kick.
72' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Clermont will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
69' Pascal Gastien has decided to make a change. Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) replaces Muhammed Cham.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maxime Gonalons trots off the pitch and is replaced by Habib Keita (Clermont).

67' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Steve Mandanda makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
66' It must be a yellow card. It is. Alidu Seidu (Rennes) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
64' 3 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Desire Doue sprays a pass out to Martin Terrier (Rennes), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 3:1.
63' Julien Stephan has decided to substitute Ludovic Blas and he is replaced by Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes).
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Desire Doue (Rennes) comes onto the pitch so that Ibrahim Salah can be given a rest.

62' 2 - 1 The ball was swung into the box by Muhammed Cham from the corner kick. He perfectly found the head of Chrislain Matsima (Clermont), who planted a header into the back of the net to make the score 2:1.
62' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Clermont.
58' 2 - 0 Goal! 2:0. Martin Terrier (Rennes) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
58' What an amazing save by Mory Diaw! Arthur Theate (Rennes) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the middle of the target, but fails.
56' Johan Gastien (Clermont) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
56' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Clermont have been awarded a corner kick.
54' Arthur Theate (Rennes) is penalised for a foul. Romain Lissorgue had a clear view and blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Clermont.
52' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though.
52' Martin Terrier (Rennes) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Ibrahim Salah, but Mory Diaw displays great awareness to stop him.
51' Maxime Gonalons plays a pass into the path of Yoel Armougom (Clermont), who shoots way too fast from mid-range and sends the ball miles over the bar.
50' Johan Gastien (Clermont) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

49' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and Clermont manage to earn a corner.
48' Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) commits a rough challenge and Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Rennes.
47' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
46' The whistle blows and Romain Lissorgue starts the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Rennes work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
44' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag and Rennes will take a corner.
43' Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
40' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the bottom right corner, but it's not enough to beat Mory Diaw who easily stops the effort.
39' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is going to take the penalty!

38' Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle after Chrislain Matsima (Clermont) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Joy for one side, despair for the other as the referee gives a penalty to Rennes!
35' Arthur Theate (Rennes) commits a foul and Romain Lissorgue immediately signals a free kick. Clermont have been awarded a free kick.
35' The ball goes out of play. Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
31' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Ibrahim Salah plays it into the box, and Warmed Omari (Rennes) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 1:0.
31' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) takes a short corner kick.
30' Martin Terrier (Rennes) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Rennes earn a corner.
29' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
25' What a chance that is! Ludovic Blas swings the ball into the box, and Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) gets in front of his man and powers his header just wide of the left post.
23' One of the players from Clermont times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
19' A short pass finds Amine Gouiri (Rennes) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
18' Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) is penalised for holding. Romain Lissorgue signals a set piece. Rennes will take a free kick near the side line.
16' Golden chance! Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
14' Martin Terrier (Rennes) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
13' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
12' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
10' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Steve Mandanda is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
9' The Rennes players can’t believe it after referee Romain Lissorgue signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
9' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Clermont! Let's see what he decides.
8' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
7' The ball is cleared after Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
5' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Rennes will kick-off.
Romain Lissorgue was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
